question: Q3
claim: Corpus-vs-consumer input is not pinned: the scorer reads raw_text tails, while the hooks feed the last assistant message (pi hook claimTextFrom; Claude stdin payload). The rows file carries no field naming the extraction (objective + raw_text only) and no extractor is in the repo, so a reader cannot verify the labels were judged against the same text the detector sees. Rows whose tails are raw output (pi-cc3cc010bbef: "done / Errors: 0 / RESULT: PASSED", labeled no) show the boundary matters.
evidence: score-completion-claims.mjs:96-126 parseRows (id, raw_text); pi/completion-evidence.ts:27-31; ~/.skilled/.labels/026-rows.jsonl row pi-cc3cc010bbef

question: Q3
claim: The verdict is tuned-parameter sensitive and the tuning is post-hoc: replaying the same calls at YES_THRESHOLD 0.7 flips stop (margin) to keep at exact margin equality (A-B=11, 10*11=110). The keep rule and margin line are pre-registered; the call threshold and the pattern vocabulary are not frozen per run.
evidence: score-completion-claims.mjs:53-54 (YES_THRESHOLD), :480-489; replay of calls.jsonl at thresholds 0.5/0.6/0.65/0.7

question: Q3
claim: No held-out set or live-corpus canary exists: the vitest suite pins synthetic fixtures (400-char edge, flips, margin, keep) with a stub jev and never touches the 110-row corpus, so the live run has no external anchor and Q2 tuning and Q3 measurement share the same rows.

question: Q3
claim: Cost is recorded but not in the verdict: latency p50/p95 and call counts exist in report.json and stdout, while the keep rule replaces the cost test with a fixed 0.10 accuracy margin (README), so a judge can be nearly break-even and cheap and still stop (margin) — and a default-on decision would need cost in the rule, not beside it.
evidence: completion-claim-audit/README.md:39-43 (keep rule and counts); report.json columns.jev.latency; score-completion-claims.mjs:480-489
